name: Discord Status
author: Amirrori
description: Shows what you're listening to as your Discord status, through Discord's official Social SDK. Needs a navidrome-discord-status bridge; no Discord tokens are stored in Navidrome.

users.reason: To receive playback reports for users

http.reason: To send playback events to the bridge on your network, look up album artwork and Spotify links, and optionally upload artwork to uguu.se

cache.reason: To cache artwork and Spotify lookups

subsonicapi.reason: To read track artwork for the optional uguu.se upload

bridgeurl.title: Bridge URL
bridgeurl.description: Base URL of your navidrome-discord-status bridge, e.g. http://192.0.2.17:8090

bridgesecret.title: Bridge secret
bridgesecret.description: The bridge's event secret, from /etc/navidrome-discord-status/credentials/event-secret on the bridge machine (at least 32 characters). Events are signed with it.

caaenabled.title: Use artwork from the Cover Art Archive (for MusicBrainz-tagged music)

cataloglookup.title: Look up artwork on Deezer and iTunes by artist and album
cataloglookup.description: Sends artist and album names to Deezer and Apple. Nothing is uploaded.

uguuenabled.title: Upload artwork to uguu.se when no other source has it
uguuenabled.description: Uploads the cover from your library to uguu.se, a public file host that deletes files after about 3 hours. Anyone with the link can see it while it exists.

spotifylinks.title: Link track and artist to Spotify
spotifylinks.description: Resolves Spotify links through ListenBrainz so others can open what you're listening to.
